reason: Create a dedicated Boss GitHub App / bot identity (Contents: write for Candidate branches, Pull requests: write, Checks: read, Metadata: read), then export CODEX_BOSS_GITHUB_TOKEN and CODEX_BOSS_GITHUB_IDENTITY for the Stable host only. Never reuse the Owner token.

a changed PR head SHA invalidates the previous CI PASS
